title: ExperienceRecord
description: Local encrypted Experience Store record (PRD §11, §16). B-S1-17 Stage-1 freeze.

record_category.description: PRD §11 categories. Stage 1 writes: correction, lexicon_entry, draft_edit, rated_exchange. limb_outcome and bench_setting are Stage 2 only.

stage.description: Product stage that produced the record.

case_id.description: Optional matter id when the experience is case-bound.

summary.description: Short human-readable pattern text used for top-K retrieval injection.

relevance_key.description: Frozen key for top-K: lowercase bag-of-words from summary + tags + category (space-separated unique tokens).

payload.description: Category-specific structured fields (not sent off-device by default).

fleet_status.description: AC-11.2: default local_only. Fleet contribution only after explicit user review.

normative_invariants: All Experience Store data is local and encrypted.
Store accumulates: corrections, lexicon entries, rated exchanges, draft edits, limb outcomes, bench settings.
Retrieval injects top-K relevant past patterns.
Optional anonymised fleet contribution only after explicit user review (never default-on).
x-caseforge.authority: CaseForge Product Owner — B-S1-17 Q-EX-01 field freeze + top-K=5 Stage-1
